name: Rixa
detailed_description:
ARRIVAL ON RIXA

Humanity sends a one way fleet to colonize a perfect empty planet called Rixa. When the fleet arrives, they soon discover the scouts made a big mistake...

Your base of operations will be the Carrier HMS Bringer of Freedom where you will plan your adventures.

ENGAGING STORYLINE WITH VOICED QUESTS

Protect the Queen's subjects from hordes of psionic aliens and gather intelligence with the help of 4 universe renown scientists through an engaging storyline. You'll soon discover the aliens have mind controlled the food source(buffalo).

5 CLASSES

Choose your class between a Marine(tank/bruiser), Android(rogue/airstrikes), Engineer(turrets/critical Strike), Survivalist(drones/attack range) and a Mage(Nuker/healer).

Optional Hardcore option if you only want 1 life. Special skins awarded to Hardcore players. Well, at least for the Marines.

Your class determines how you will generate Nanobots to use for abilities. 

UNIQUE NANOBOT ABILITY SYSTEM

Upon leveling up you will put points into a unique ability system that uses Nanobots instead of the traditional Mana system.

You must first generate different color nanobots based on your class and/or weapon stats. A Basic Turret(above) requires one orange nanobot to use.

Some abilities require two different color Nanobots to use. The Burst ability(above) requires one orange and one purple to use as outlined by the coloring of ability icon itself.

You'll need to increase your max nanobot count through the help of weapons, class quests, or abilities. More powerful abilities require more Nanobots to use.

POWERFUL WEAPONS

Airstrikes, drones, turrets, rifles, MELEE ENJOYERS, and something for the healers.

Secure powerful weapons that will display on your back. You can equip up to 5 weapons at one time. Stats such as damage reduction, health, movement speed all roll on weapons instead of armor. There is no armor other than cosmetics.

DUNGEONS

Explore 5 man dungeons as you level up with friends or randoms to secure powerful loot.

This is a coop game so difficulty will be balanced around a full party. Though if you're strong enough you should be able to solo some content.

Combat is tab targeting but don't worry, there is technology to assist with the rapid deployment of rounds down range..

short_description: Team up with friends as a melee enjoyer or use unethical ranged abilities to fight the alien menace in this Sci-fi meets Fantasy MMORPG. That's right.. SCI-FI MMORPG!! Explore the planet of Rixa using a unique NanoBot ability system and a host of weapons at your disposal. For the Queen!!!!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended.
